title: freshness-nav2: code and raw traces for "Freshness Is a Pipeline Property: Testing Temporal Obligations in Nav2 Command Chains" (ITT 2026)
description: Experiment runner, finite-trace monitor, audit and analysis scripts, raw traces (80-trial main campaign and 60-trial availability-control campaign), container recipe, and LaTeX source for the ITT 2026 paper. make verify recomputes every result from the raw traces without ROS; make campaign re-runs the ROS 2 Jazzy / Nav2 1.3.13 experiment in a container.
